statements: Recommended maximum throughput capacities, MAPX / MOPX series
Throughput capacities in litres per hour
1) "Rust and Oxidation" type.
Note! Maximum density of oil 991 kg/m3 at 15 °C. Density preferably measured at 50 °C and according to ASTM method D 1298-80, corrected to 15 °C according to ASTM tables D 1250-80.
For heavy fuel oil cleaning plants dimensioned specifically for operation in series the recommended maximum throughput capacities are increased by 35 % (purifier-clarifier plus stand-by).
